iphone-pro.author: Amina K.
iphone-pro.title: Camera is worth it
iphone-pro.body: Bought the 256GB in Nairobi. Serial on the invoice, sealed box. Camera in low light is what sold me.

iphone-pro.author: Brian O.
iphone-pro.title: Solid daily phone
iphone-pro.body: Battery lasts a full workday with maps and WhatsApp. Staff walked me through Lipa Mdogo Mdogo clearly.

iphone-pro-max.author: Faith M.
iphone-pro-max.title: Battery monster
iphone-pro-max.body: 1TB for photo work. Screen is huge but still usable one-handed at the edges. Happy with the price we got.

iphone-duo.author: Daniel W.
iphone-duo.title: Fold that feels finished
iphone-duo.body: Outer screen is actually useful. Collected same day after WhatsApp confirmation.

iphone-air.author: Grace N.
iphone-air.title: Light in the bag
iphone-air.body: Thinnest phone I have owned. Pocket friendly. Wish it had a louder speaker but otherwise great.

iphone-17.author: Kevin L.
iphone-17.title: Best value sealed unit
iphone-17.body: Needed a sealed 17 for work. Invoice had the serial. No drama.
